The '''MiOrd clan''' were a rogue branch of the [[Remplish]] clan that dwelled on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], before being driven off-world during a [[Sullust holy war|holy war]]. [[Hepmaga MiOrd]] was a later member of the clan.
